command: set -euo pipefail; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); OLD=$(mktemp /tmp/blueeye-old.XXXXXX.apk); trap 'rm -f "$OLD"' EXIT; P=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path io.blueeye | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^package://p' | head -n1); adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$P" "$OLD" >/dev/null; APKSIGNER=$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -name apksigner -type f | sort -V | tail -1); test -x "$APKSIGNER"; echo OLD_CERT; "$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs "$OLD" | grep -E 'Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest'; echo NEW_CERT; "$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs /tmp/BlueEye-Tracker-db8c3ce.apk | grep -E 'Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest'
